annotations.text:
Reached from: the logo, every return visit, closing a page.
Leads to: Continue, the route shown (last opened), a ready node, Review, the weekly problem, Your whole network.
Only the route you last opened is drawn here; the full network lives on Your knowledge.

Reached from: first visit, “Learn something new”, “Ask for a goal”, a search with no match.
Leads to: placement, or the route.
Targets are suggested and confirmed by the learner; the route is computed from what each page needs.

Reached from: Home, Start, Explore.
Leads to: any ready node, following a missing node, the Labs pipeline at the end.
Top: the outcome, honest time left with a pace estimate, progress per line (near goals keep people going). Map + selected-stop panel (the roadmap.sh pattern). Bottom: what can start now (max 4) and milestones — a problem per line, the Labs pipeline at the end.

Reached from: a route, Continue, search, Needed-by / Goes-deeper links, Labs.
Leads to: needs (back), goes deeper / related (sideways), needed by (forward), the problem, back to the route.
A block document: every dark tag names the block type the AI wrote through the Studio API (toggle “showBlocks”). Figures are library components filled with data; the image carries author and licence. Try-it questions return in review; the Rosalind-style problem settles the node.

Reached from: Home, search.
Leads to: starting or continuing a track; Start to ask for a new goal.
Search first; filters with counts; applied filters as removable chips; dense rows sorted by how much you already hold. Network view shows only filtered tracks.

Reached from: the account menu, “Your whole network” on Home.
Leads to: any node, review, re-placement.
Areas that share no nodes are drawn as separate maps and join automatically when a route links them. A List view covers everything as text.
Opened from the avatar on every learner page: knowledge, solved problems, routes, theme, and Studio for the team.

Reached from: Inbox, the rail.
Leads to: Implementing (accept), an existing node (merge), or a declined note the learner sees.
Saved views, filters with counts, a dense table with duplicates collapsed, a detail pane, a bulk bar and one-key decisions (Linear’s triage pattern). The model proposes and groups; only a person moves a request, and each decision is logged.

Reached from: accepting a request.
Leads to: the node workbench (open), review, land.
Saved views, filters, rows grouped by stage and collapsible, bulk assign, a stalled flag instead of due dates, and team load to help assign.

Reached from: Tracks in the rail, Inbox.
Leads to: a published named track in Explore.
Each number on the map is a text the AI wrote. Pick one (or J/K through them): it sits beside the two claims it may use and its automatic checks; approve, suggest an edit, or ask for a rewrite (GitHub-review style). The strip below tracks every text by kind.

Reached from: a node in Graph, Implementing, Inbox.
Leads to: the figure composer, problem builder, review.
CMS patterns: tabs (Content, Links, Problem, Settings); an outline of blocks (Gutenberg list view); the block editor with add-block points; side panels (Preview, Checks, Sources, History, Comments) with a live, click-to-edit preview (Wagtail, Sanity, Storyblok); a pre-submit checklist.

Reached from: the Figure hole in the workbench.
Data first, as a sheet (Datawrapper, Flourish); settings generated from the component’s schema (Storybook controls); the assistant can make described changes; preview with every interaction state; a Describe step for caption, alt text and data source; checks that point at the field to fix; the component version pinned, with where else it’s used.

Reached from: the rail.
Leads to: a node’s workbench, split/merge, a weave preview for any goal.
Search-first with a region tree (Bloom, WebProtégé); a layered neighbourhood view for editing, with Table and Whole network as alternatives (node-link views stop being readable past ~20 nodes); the three link kinds drawn differently; the impact of a change shown before it is proposed; link history. Switch Editing view / Learner view (click it, or the “view” tweak): learners only ever see the metro style, and the learner view shows the change on their maps.

Reached from: the rail, “Ask the assistant” in the workbench, a request or a route.
Every chat is tied to a node, request or route. The assistant acts only through the content API; each action is a card you keep or discard. Kept changes become drafts that still need checks and review. It cannot approve, publish, land or move requests.

Reached from: AI at the bottom of the rail.
Tokens and cost by task, person and model, from the LiteLLM gateway; budget meters and alerts that say what happens when a cap is reached. Chart colours validated for colour-blind separation; the tables are its accessible view.
The three lanes from Labs (no AI, self-hosted, hosted keys), the fixed list of places Code calls a model with a model, fallback and cap for each, and budgets.

Comeni Code — key pages, hybrid identity, light mode (dark is on the Identity page).

The idea: nodes are standalone pages; a goal is woven into a route by following what each page needs. AI suggests targets and writes short connecting text (marked until reviewed); it never chooses the route. Missing pages go to a request queue, and only a person moves them to Implementing.

Navigation: learner top bar = logo · search · account. Home is the overview. Lessons use a focused bar.
